verdict.rationale: Docs claim cited, auditable outputs (e.g., 'produces a comprehensive cited report,' 'trace any finding back to the specific code or literature passage') and access to 175M+ papers with citation graph understanding, supporting the story's core intent. However, this is vendor-only documentation with no independent verification, no example output showing actual inline citations, and no detail on citation format/consistency across all agents (e.g., Molecules, Precedent). missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of citation quality, concrete example of a cited report output, confirmation that ALL agent types (not just Kosmos/Crow) consistently provide citations for every claim.
